# Kushan Esala

> Official portfolio of Kushan Esala, an Associate Research And Development Engineer and software engineer in Sri Lanka.

Kushan builds production SaaS applications, backend services, business systems, AI-assisted automation, data workflows, and Linux-based infrastructure. The portfolio presents verified professional experience, selected commercial systems, academic work, technical skills, and contact information.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://kushanesala.me/): Official portfolio and professional overview.
- [About](https://kushanesala.me/#about): Engineering focus, background, education, and certifications.
- [Experience](https://kushanesala.me/#experience): Current and previous software engineering roles.
- [Skills](https://kushanesala.me/#skills): Languages, frameworks, data tools, automation, cloud, and DevOps capabilities.
- [Projects](https://kushanesala.me/#projects): Commercial systems, final-year research, and selected academic projects.
- [Contact](https://kushanesala.me/#contact): Contact form for engineering work, SaaS builds, and product demonstrations.
